messages.author: b248ee5e96322fc9
messages.subject: Points on AKDE Plot
parts:
Hi ctmm Community,

I have an AKDE plot with my as.telemetry points and right now they are showing up as open red circles but I would like for them to be closed or filled red circles. I have tried using pch written in various different ways and nothing is changing. Any suggestions as to how I can change the appearance of my AKDE plot points? 

This is the section of my code as it stands:
###############################################################
ds.tel.4 <- as.telemetry(df4)

GUESS <- ctmm.guess(ds.tel.4, interactive = FALSE)
FIT <- ctmm.fit(ds.tel.4, GUESS, method = 'pHREML')

# Develop and plot UD
UD <- occurrence(ds.tel.4,FIT)
class(UD)
plot(UD,col.level=NA)
title (main = "Utilization Distribution ID 4")

# Develop and plot AKDE
UD1 <- akde(ds.tel.4,FIT)
plot(ds.tel.4, UD = UD1) ***I'm assuming this is the line of code I would have to edit***
title (main = "AKDE ID 4")
dev.print(pdf, "UD_AKDE_4.pdf")  # save plot to working directory as .pdf
###############################################################

messages.author: 7d868ffe3daa8319
messages.subject: Re: [ctmm-user] Points on AKDE Plot
parts:
Hi Mackenzie,

To change the graphical parameters for points, you'll want to specify error=FALSE in the plot() function. If you do this, the standard graphical parameter settings for base plots should work.

Jesse

messages.subject: Re: [ctmm-user] Points on AKDE Plot
parts:
Additionally, you can switch from error circles to error discs with error=2 in plot(). With error=1...2, you should be able to modify the color with col and transparency with transparency.error (which gets lighter with larger errors).

Best,
Chris
